observational_status: Six normalized-native M3D-C1 open-loop source cases with no imported experimental shots, calibrated source current, equilibrium/profile handoff, or segmented controller-in-loop
successful_milestone: Six fixed-dt=0.000625 normalized-native M3D-C1 runs completed in 485.79 seconds with zero-source equivalence exact (max metric delta 0). Native HDF5-derived width, peak-J, high-J, center/shoulder and reconnection/energy diagnostics were extracted at three matched times; finite signed current response was observed.
interpretation: All 12 tested signed-amplitude/time comparisons failed the frozen width gain >+0.020% gate. The largest extracted width gain was +0.00810% (positive double at t=0.01), and at t=0.03 the largest was +0.00385% (negative double). All Jpk changes stayed within +0.10%. Reconnection flux and magnetic-energy deltas were zero at extraction precision. This is a scientific negative for the open-loop width gate, not a pipeline failure. The ROI-derived W_sheet remains an uncalibrated diagnostic and temporal convergence is unvalidated.
followup_scope: One bounded native-HDF5 width ROI sensitivity audit across R half-width 0.20/0.25/0.30, with unchanged source, fine dt, signed amplitudes, frozen thresholds and zero-source control; no new solver physics or controller claim.
handoff_equivalence: unvalidated; zero-source equivalence is not shot handoff
pb11_fidelity_limits: not_applicable; no p-B11 reaction, proton recirculation, radiation/electron loss, alpha transport/channeling, boron delivery, direct conversion, rotating plasma, rotation/shear, liquid lithium, ignition margin or net-power evidence
m3dc1_claim_boundary: Normalized-native M3D-C1 open-loop fixed-dt current-drive metrics only; no calibrated physical current/width, temporal convergence, segmented-electrode authority, experimental shot handoff, causal TCT stabilization or reactor net power.
